description: PhantomShell v5.0 — Unified Command Registry. Single source of truth for help system, tab completion, and argument validation.

help.description: Display help information for commands or categories

args.name: topic
args.description: Command name or category to get detailed help for

args.name: directory
args.description: Target directory. Defaults to $HOME. Use '-' for previous directory.

history.description: Display command history. Use !! to repeat last command, !N to repeat command N.

pty.description: Spawn a fully interactive PTY shell (python pty.spawn or script fallback)

alias.description: Show all command aliases (ll, la, cls, .., bg, dir, type, etc.)

mode.description: Display current operating mode (FULL, NORMAL, or MINIMAL)

capabilities.description: Display all detected server capabilities (memory, exec, disk, proc_open, fork, network)

exit.description: Disconnect from the target and allow reconnection

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the file to display

head.description: Display the first N lines of a file (default 10)

tail.description: Display the last N lines of a file (default 10)

ls.description: List directory contents with color output

args.name: args
args.description: Any ls flags and/or target path (e.g. -la /tmp)

upload.description: Upload a file via base64 encoding. Send base64 data terminated by --EOF-- line.

download.description: Download a file from the target encoded as base64 between --BEGIN-B64-- and --END-B64-- markers

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the file to download

edit.description: Interactive line editor. Supports insert (i), append (a), delete (d), replace (r), print (p), save (w), save+quit (wq), quit (q).

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the file to edit (created if not exists)

args.name: args
args.description: Flags and file path(s) to remove

args.name: args
args.description: Directory path to create, optionally with -p for parents

touch.description: Create an empty file or update file timestamp

args.name: file
args.description: File path to create or update

sysinfo.description: Comprehensive system enumeration: hostname, kernel, OS, CPU, memory, disk, users, interfaces, DNS, routes, listening ports, processes, crontabs, SUID binaries

services.description: List running services (systemctl or service --status-all fallback)

ports.description: Show listening TCP ports (ss -tlnp or netstat fallback)

netmap.description: Map the local network: discover subnets, hosts, and services on adjacent segments

args.name: subnet
args.description: Target subnet in CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24). Auto-detected if omitted.

vuln_scan.description: Full vulnerability scanner: kernel CVEs (DirtyCow, OverlayFS, DirtyPipe, GameOverlay, nf_tables, Netfilter, StackRot, DirtyCredential), SUID+GTFOBins, sudo CVEs, docker socket, polkit/PwnKit, writable cron, capabilities, /etc/passwd+shadow permissions, SSH keys, config files

exploit_suggest.description: Suggest kernel exploits based on detected kernel version. Checks DirtyCow, PwnKit, DirtyPipe, GameOverlay, nf_tables, Baron Samedit.

exploit_fetch.description: Download exploit source code from exploit-db or GitHub by CVE ID

exploit_compile.description: Compile a previously fetched exploit (gcc with various fallback flags)

args.name: cve
args.description: CVE identifier matching the fetched source file

privesc_check.description: Enumerate privilege escalation vectors: SUID, SGID, sudo, cron, capabilities, writable PATH, docker/LXD groups, NFS, internal ports, writable /etc files

privesc_auto.description: Attempt automatic privilege escalation via PwnKit (CVE-2021-4034), GameOverlay (CVE-2023-2640), and DirtyPipe (CVE-2022-0847)

privesc_suggest.description: Display a manual privilege escalation checklist (sudo, SUID, cron, capabilities, PATH hijack, LD_PRELOAD, kernel exploits, docker, NFS, /etc/passwd)

portscan.description: TCP port scanner with banner grabbing and service identification

args.name: ports
args.description: Port specification: single (80), range (1-1024), comma-separated (22,80,443), or mixed (22,80,1000-2000)

args.name: timeout
args.description: Connection timeout in seconds per port (default: 1.0)

connect.description: Connect to a remote TCP port interactively. Use ~. to disconnect.

listen.description: Bind and listen on a TCP port, accept one connection interactively. Ctrl+C to cancel.

bannergrab.description: Grab service banner from a remote host:port. Sends protocol-appropriate probes for HTTP, SMTP.

pivot_list.description: List all available pivoting methods with usage instructions

pivot_portfwd.description: PHP-native TCP port forwarder. Forwards local port to remote host:port. Ctrl+C to stop.

pivot_socks.description: Start a SOCKS4 proxy server on port 1080 for proxychains. Ctrl+C to stop.

pivot_tunnel.description: Create a TCP tunnel (reverse port forward): expose remote host:port on a local port

args.name: lport
args.description: Local port to expose the tunnel on

dns_tunnel.description: Establish a DNS tunnel for covert data exfiltration and C2 communication. Encodes data in DNS queries to bypass firewalls.

args.name: domain
args.description: Controlled domain for DNS tunneling (e.g. t.evil.com)

args.name: nameserver
args.description: Custom DNS server to route queries through

icmp_tunnel.description: Establish an ICMP tunnel for covert communication. Encapsulates data in ICMP echo request/reply payloads.

args.name: server_ip
args.description: IP address of the ICMP tunnel server (attacker)

ws_tunnel.description: Establish a WebSocket tunnel. Wraps TCP traffic inside WebSocket frames to bypass HTTP-aware firewalls and proxies.

args.name: local_port
args.description: Local port to bind the tunnel endpoint (default: 1080)

pipe_tunnel.description: Create a named pipe (FIFO) based tunnel for inter-process or inter-host communication without network sockets

ssh_tunnel.description: Programmatic SSH tunnel creation (dynamic SOCKS, local forward, remote forward) without shelling out to ssh binary

persist_all.description: Install ALL persistence mechanisms at once (cron + ssh + systemd + rc + motd + php + web)

persist_cron.description: Add a crontab entry that re-executes the shell every minute. Also attempts /etc/cron.d/ placement.

persist_ssh.description: Add an SSH public key to authorized_keys for persistent access

persist_systemd.description: Create a systemd service unit for persistence. Falls back to user-level service if system-level fails.

persist_rc.description: Append shell execution to .bashrc, .profile, and .zshrc for login persistence

persist_motd.description: Place a persistence script in /etc/update-motd.d/ to execute on user login

persist_ldpreload.description: Compile a shared library and register it via /etc/ld.so.preload for automatic loading into every process

persist_php.description: Set auto_prepend_file in php.ini or .user.ini to auto-load the shell on every PHP request

persist_web.description: Drop a minimal web shell (.info.php / .health.php) in writable web directories

clean_logs.description: Truncate auth.log, syslog, messages, secure, apache/nginx access+error logs, wtmp, btmp. Clears bash history.

clean_self.description: Self-destruct: shred + delete the shell binary, remove all persistence copies and history, then exit

hide_process.description: Rename the process title to a legitimate-looking kernel thread name (e.g. [kworker/0:2])

hide_connection.description: Compile an LD_PRELOAD shared library to hide network connections from ss/netstat

timestomp.description: Modify file timestamps to match a reference file or reset to a fixed date (2020-01-01)

args.name: reference_file
args.description: Reference file to copy timestamps from. If omitted, sets to 2020-01-01.

alter_conn.description: Spawn a new reverse shell to a different listener (bash, python3, or PHP fallback), then migrate

memory_only.description: Execute payloads entirely in memory without touching disk. Uses memfd_create or /dev/shm for fileless execution.

args.name: payload_url
args.description: URL to fetch the payload from (fetched into memory, never written to disk)

lateral_ssh.description: Attempt SSH lateral movement with optional password. Tests access by running 'id' on target.

args.name: password
args.description: SSH password (uses sshpass). Omit for key-based auth.

lateral_scp.description: Copy files to/from remote hosts via SCP

args.name: args
args.description: SCP arguments: source path and user@host:destination

lateral_wmi.description: Execute commands on remote Windows hosts via WMI (requires impacket wmiexec.py)

args.name: target
args.description: Target in user@host or domain/user@host format

args.name: command
args.description: Command to execute on the remote host

lateral_smb.description: Enumerate or access SMB shares on remote hosts (requires smbclient)

args.name: share
args.description: Specific share name to connect to. Omit to list shares.

lateral_dcom.description: Execute commands on remote Windows hosts via DCOM objects (MMC20.Application, ShellWindows, ShellBrowserWindow)

args.name: command
args.description: Command to execute on the remote host

lateral_winrm.description: Execute commands on remote Windows hosts via WinRM (Windows Remote Management) using the WS-Management protocol

args.name: command
args.description: Command or PowerShell script to execute

lateral_psremoting.description: Execute commands via PowerShell Remoting (Enter-PSSession / Invoke-Command) for interactive or batch remote execution

args.name: command
args.description: PowerShell command or scriptblock to execute remotely

steal_all.description: Run all credential harvesting modules at once: configs, SSH keys, history, passwords, /etc files, browsers

steal_configs.description: Find and extract credentials from config files (.env, wp-config.php, config.php, settings.inc.php, database.yml)

steal_ssh.description: Find and display SSH private keys (id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa) from /home and /root

steal_history.description: Extract password-related entries from bash_history, zsh_history, and mysql_history files

steal_passwords.description: Grep for password patterns across /var/www, /opt, /srv, and /home directories

steal_etc.description: Extract interesting entries from /etc/passwd (shells, uid:0) and /etc/shadow (crackable hashes)

steal_browsers.description: Find browser credential stores: logins.json (Firefox), Login Data (Chrome), cookies databases

ad_enum.description: Full Active Directory enumeration: domain info, trusts, sites, naming contexts, functional level

args.name: domain
args.description: Target domain FQDN. Auto-detected from DNS/environment if omitted.

ad_users.description: Enumerate AD users: list accounts, identify privileged users, check for AS-REP roastable accounts, find disabled accounts

args.name: filter
args.description: LDAP filter or keyword to narrow results (e.g. 'admin', 'enabled', 'asrep')

ad_groups.description: Enumerate AD groups and their memberships. Highlights privileged groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, etc.)

ad_computers.description: Enumerate AD computer objects: OS versions, unconstrained delegation, LAPS-enabled machines

ad_spns.description: Enumerate Service Principal Names for Kerberoasting attacks. Finds user accounts with SPNs set.

ad_delegation.description: Find accounts with unconstrained, constrained, or resource-based constrained delegation configured

ad_rbcd.description: Resource-Based Constrained Delegation attack: configure msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity to impersonate users

args.name: target_computer
args.description: Computer account to configure RBCD on (e.g. DC01$)

args.name: controlled_account
args.description: Account you control that will be allowed to delegate

ad_shadow_creds.description: Shadow Credentials attack: add a Key Credential to a target's msDS-KeyCredentialLink for PKINIT authentication

args.name: target
args.description: Target account (user or computer) to add shadow credentials to

ad_adcs.description: Enumerate Active Directory Certificate Services: find vulnerable certificate templates (ESC1-ESC8), CAs, and enrollment rights

args.name: check
args.description: Specific ESC check to run (e.g. 'esc1', 'esc4', 'esc8'). Runs all if omitted.

ad_laps.description: Read LAPS (Local Administrator Password Solution) passwords from AD. Requires read access to ms-Mcs-AdmPwd attribute.

args.name: computer
args.description: Specific computer name to query. Reads all accessible if omitted.

ad_gmsa.description: Read Group Managed Service Account (gMSA) passwords from AD. Extracts msDS-ManagedPassword if accessible.

args.name: account
args.description: Specific gMSA account name. Lists all gMSA accounts if omitted.

ad_dacl.description: Enumerate Discretionary Access Control Lists on AD objects. Find GenericAll, WriteDACL, WriteOwner, and other abusable permissions.

args.name: target
args.description: Target AD object (user, group, computer, OU) to analyze

ad_gpo.description: Enumerate Group Policy Objects: find GPOs with immediate impact, writable GPOs, GPO links, and password policies in GPP

ad_coerce.description: Coerce authentication from target machine accounts using PetitPotam, PrinterBug, DFSCoerce, or ShadowCoerce

args.name: target
args.description: Target host to coerce authentication from

args.name: listener
args.description: Listener IP to capture the authentication

ad_ntlm_relay.description: Set up NTLM relay attack: relay captured NTLM authentication to target services (LDAP, SMB, HTTP, MSSQL)

args.name: target
args.description: Target URL or host to relay authentication to

ad_golden_ticket.description: Forge a Golden Ticket using the krbtgt NTLM hash for domain-wide persistence

args.name: krbtgt_hash
args.description: NTLM hash of the krbtgt account

ad_silver_ticket.description: Forge a Silver Ticket using a service account's NTLM hash for targeted service access

args.name: service_hash
args.description: NTLM hash of the service account

c2_http.description: Set up HTTP-based command and control channel. Supports beaconing, jitter, and encrypted payloads.

c2_discord.description: Use Discord webhook/bot as a covert C2 channel for command execution and data exfiltration

args.name: endpoint
args.description: Discord webhook URL or bot token

args.name: channel_id
args.description: Discord channel ID (required for bot token mode)

c2_telegram.description: Use Telegram bot API as a covert C2 channel for command execution and data exfiltration

args.name: chat_id
args.description: Telegram chat/group ID to communicate through

c2_beacon.description: Generic beacon mode: periodically check in with C2 server, execute queued commands, report results

c2_dns.description: DNS-based C2 channel: encode commands and responses in DNS TXT/CNAME queries for firewall evasion

args.name: domain
args.description: Controlled domain for DNS C2 (e.g. c2.evil.com)

args.name: nameserver
args.description: Custom nameserver to route DNS queries through

args.name: record_type
args.description: DNS record type to use: 'TXT', 'CNAME', 'A', 'AAAA' (default: TXT)

exfil.description: Exfiltrate data from the target via multiple methods: HTTP POST, DNS, ICMP, or file copy

args.name: destination
args.description: Destination URL, host, or path depending on method

compress.description: Compress files or directories for exfiltration (tar.gz, zip, or gzip)

auto_root.description: Automated privilege escalation pipeline: runs vuln_scan, exploit_suggest, privesc_check, then attempts privesc_auto

auto_pivot.description: Automated network pivoting: discover internal subnets, scan for live hosts, set up SOCKS proxy and port forwards

args.name: subnet
args.description: Target subnet (auto-detected from interfaces if omitted)

auto_persist.description: Automated persistence: detect writable locations and install the most appropriate persistence mechanisms

auto_clean.description: Automated cleanup: remove all persistence, clean logs, timestomp modified files, self-destruct

auto_report.description: Generate an operation report: summarize enumeration results, exploits used, credentials found, persistence installed

playbook_run.description: Execute a predefined attack playbook by name. Playbooks chain multiple commands into automated attack sequences.

args.name: vars
args.description: Comma-separated key=value variables for playbook parameterization

playbook_list.description: List all available attack playbooks with brief descriptions

playbook_show.description: Display the full details of a playbook: steps, required variables, expected output, and prerequisites

args.name: name
args.description: Playbook name to display details for

background.description: Run a command in the background as a managed job (requires proc_open)

args.name: command
args.description: Command to run in the background

fg.description: Bring a background job to the foreground. Use Ctrl+C to send it back to background.

args.name: job_id
args.description: Job ID from 'jobs' output. Defaults to most recent job.

jobs.description: List all background jobs with their PID, status, and command

kill.description: Kill a process by PID or a background job by %job_id

token_impersonate.description: Impersonate a token from another process or use SeImpersonatePrivilege for privilege escalation (Potato-style attacks)

args.name: target
args.description: PID to steal token from, or method: 'potato', 'printspoofer', 'godpotato' (default: auto-detect best method)

token_steal.description: Steal and duplicate an access token from a target process for impersonation

args.name: pid
args.description: Process ID to steal the token from

cred_dump.description: Dump credentials from LSASS, SAM, SECURITY hives, or cached credentials. Multiple methods: MiniDump, registry, nanodump.

registry_read.description: Read Windows registry keys and values. Supports HKLM, HKCU, HKCR, HKU, HKCC hives.

args.name: value_name
args.description: Specific value name to read. Lists all values if omitted.

registry_write.description: Write or create Windows registry keys and values for persistence, configuration changes, or security policy modification

args.name: value_name
args.description: Registry value name to create or modify

args.name: value_data
args.description: Data to write to the registry value

service_create.description: Create a Windows service for persistence or privilege escalation. Can run as SYSTEM.

args.name: binary_path
args.description: Path to the service binary or command to execute

uac_bypass.description: Bypass User Account Control using various techniques: fodhelper, eventvwr, computerdefaults, sdclt, cmstp, or DiskCleanup

args.name: command
args.description: Command to execute with elevated privileges

amsi_bypass.description: Bypass Antimalware Scan Interface (AMSI) to allow execution of flagged PowerShell/C# payloads

etw_bypass.description: Bypass Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) to prevent logging of .NET assembly loads and suspicious activities

cloud_metadata.description: Query cloud instance metadata services (AWS 169.254.169.254, GCP, Azure IMDS). Extract credentials, instance info, user-data scripts.

cloud_enum.description: Enumerate cloud resources: S3 buckets, IAM roles, Azure subscriptions, GCP projects, storage accounts, key vaults
